conventions: Items stone_button/oak_button/lever used via ItemStack.useOn(UseOnContext(connection-less ServerPlayer, MAIN_HAND, BlockHitResult(centre of clicked face, face, clicked pos, false))). P=(96,150,96). Player yaw/pitch as Minecraft (yaw 0=south,90=west,180=north,270=east; pitch -60 looks up, +60 down). A rows: [block, yaw, pitch, clicked_face of stone at P, state at P+face or null]. B rows: [block, clicked_block (placed at D+d), d (clicked block is on side d of D, click face = opposite of d, destination D=P), stone cells at D+s, several joined with + (null=none, 5 names = all neighbours except d), yaw, pitch, state at D or null]. C: stone at P, switch placed on its north face (wall) at P.north by useOn; sched = tick indices (after N ServerLevel.tick calls) at which BlockState.useWithoutItem is called; ticks[i] = powered after i ServerLevel.tick calls (0..40), -1 = block gone; uses = [tick, InteractionResult].
